column1: # Extra trees compared by validate-script-drift.sh (one path per line).
Each path is a directory containing a `scripts/` subtree whose files are
compared against every other tree by path. The repo root .pi/ and every
immediate subdirectory carrying .pi/scripts are always compared; list here
trees that are NOT in that shape.
This repo ships a canonical tree (templates/pi) and mirrors it to .pi/.
